name: Audit AI search visibility
prompt: Check our visibility in AI search for our main product category.
expected_behavior: Reads .agents/<productname>/product.md for brand and product context
Evaluates brand mentions and sentiment in LLM-generated responses
Checks presence in AI search engines (like Perplexity or ChatGPT)
Provides a visibility score and highlights gaps
Suggests actionable steps to improve AI search visibility (AEO)

name: Check visibility against competitors
prompt: How does our AI visibility compare to our top competitor?
expected_behavior: Identifies the top competitor or asks for their name
Compares AI search mentions, sentiment, and accuracy for both brands
Highlights areas where the competitor dominates AI responses
Suggests strategies to displace the competitor in AI search results
